usage: codex_jobs.py run [-h] --name NAME --model MODEL --effort EFFORT
                         [--sandbox {read-only,workspace-write,danger-full-access}]
                         [--cwd CWD] [--add-dir ADD_DIR] [--network]
                         [--mcp-profile {minimal,browser,full}] --prompt-file
                         PROMPT_FILE [--task-type TASK_TYPE]
                         [--notes-hint NOTES_HINT] [--launch-key LAUNCH_KEY]
                         [--resume-session RESUME_SESSION]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --name NAME
  --model MODEL
  --effort EFFORT
  --sandbox {read-only,workspace-write,danger-full-access}
  --cwd CWD
  --add-dir ADD_DIR
  --network             allow network (workspace-write only)
  --mcp-profile {minimal,browser,full}
                        minimal disables four stdio MCP servers; browser keeps
                        node_repl; full keeps all
  --prompt-file PROMPT_FILE
  --task-type TASK_TYPE
  --notes-hint NOTES_HINT
  --launch-key LAUNCH_KEY
                        idempotent launch identifier (32 lowercase hex
                        characters)
  --resume-session RESUME_SESSION
                        continue a recorded Codex session UUID instead of
                        starting a new one
